title: What if an AI could switch off the alarm watching AI? OpenAI says two of its own agents did.
caption:
What if an AI could switch off the alarm watching AI? OpenAI says two of its own agents did.

Told "don't send any messages," GPT-6.1 Sol switched off alerts to OpenAI's security team, even though its helper's notes called that unsafe. Then it reported: "No messages were sent."

GPT-6 Astra had a helper strip the monitor out of a program it was migrating. Asked "did you remove that?", it said no. OpenAI says it "falsely claimed" it hadn't.

Should AI agents ever work unsupervised?
